nav_perGameGroupTitle: Applies to all games, overridable per game
storeInstall_folderHint: The game gets a folder of its own in here.
storeInstall_noRunners: No runner installed yet. Download one under Runners first.
storeInstall_noteTitle: After the download, Prefixr sets up the prefix
storeInstall_noteText: What the game needs in its prefix (Visual C++ runtimes, DirectX and the like) is installed on its first start. Launch options, MangoHud and Gamescope work as for every game and can be changed later.
stores_intro: Connect your store accounts and their games show up in the library, ready to install. Prefixr sets up a prefix and runner for each game and starts it like any other.
stores_toolHint: Connecting downloads {tool}, the tool Prefixr talks to the store with.
stores_loginHint: “Connect” opens the store's sign-in page in a Prefixr window that picks up the code by itself. To use your browser's password manager or “Sign in with Google”, pick “Connect in the browser”; there you copy the code back here yourself.
stores_loginStepOpen: Sign in on the page that opened in your browser.
stores_loginStepCode: The page then shows a short text. Copy all of it, or just the value of authorizationCode, and paste it here.
stores_loginStepCodeGog: The browser then shows an almost empty GOG page. Copy its address from the address bar and paste it here.
stores_loginStepCodeAmazon: After signing in, the browser shows Amazon's homepage. Copy its address from the address bar and paste it here.
stores_codePlaceholder: Paste the page or the authorizationCode…
stores_toolLine: Uses {tool} {version} from the Heroic Games Launcher project (needs Python 3).
stores_toolLineStandalone: Uses {tool} {version} from the Heroic Games Launcher project.
stores_disconnectConfirmMessage: You'll be signed out of {store} and its not-installed games leave the library. Installed games stay; starting one asks you to connect again.
gameList_emptyLibrary_title: No games in your library yet
gameList_emptyLibrary_hint: Add your first game to get started.
gameList_steam_doneRemovedBoth: “{name}” was removed from the library and from Steam.{restarted}
gameList_steam_doneAddedNextStartSuffix: It will appear the next time Steam starts.
gameList_steam_confirmMessage: Steam is currently running and would overwrite the change again. Prefixr will quit Steam, {action}, and restart Steam afterward. A running Steam game will be closed in the process.
gameList_steam_closeFirstMessage: Prefixr can't see or quit Steam from its Flatpak, and a running Steam would overwrite the change. Close Steam if it is running, then confirm, and Prefixr will {action}.
gameCard_removeConfirmMessage: “{name}” will be removed from the library{steamPart}. The prefix and game files will remain.
gameCard_uninstallConfirmMessage: “{name}” will be uninstalled: its files are deleted and it leaves the library{steamPart}. It stays in your store library and can be installed again. The prefix remains.
gameForm_inheritHint: By default the global settings under “{page}” apply. What you change here only applies to this game and is highlighted.
gameForm_missingFields: Please fill in the name, exe, prefix and runner.
gameForm_prefixEmptyHint: No prefix yet — create one first under "Prefixes & Runners".
gameForm_runnerNoProtonfixesHint: No protonfixes match yet, look for one in the {tab} tab.
gameForm_envVarsHint: Take precedence over all switches in the other tabs.
gameForm_notesPlaceholder: e.g. offline login: RELOADED / 1, or why a setting is needed
gameForm_notesHint: Shown on the game's card. Kept as plain text in config.json, so don't put real passwords here.
gameForm_notesFormatHint: A line ending in ":" becomes a heading, lines starting with "- " a list; an indented line continues the item above.
artworkPicker_hintWide: Steam only: the wide image, e.g. under “Recently played”.
artworkPicker_hintHero: Steam only: the banner at the top of the game's page.
artworkPicker_hintLogo: Steam only: the logo over the hero banner.
installDialog_introRest: will be run in a prefix to install it. Prefixr will then automatically try to find the game's exe from the shortcuts created.
installDialog_closeHint: Close the setup window once the installation is finished.
installDialog_candidatesHint: Shortcut(s) found after installation — which one launches the game?
installDialog_noCandidatesHint: No matching shortcut was found. Choose the game's exe manually. If setup failed, the log shows why.
umuPicker_intro: With the right ID, umu applies fixes for exactly this game, and Proton its game-specific tweaks. Without an ID, only general fixes apply.
umuPicker_noMatches: No matches for “{query}”. Not every game needs its own fixes.
umuPicker_matchesHint: Steam matches come from SteamGridDB, the rest from the umu database. With several stores, pick the one the game came from.
umuPicker_manualHintBefore: A plain Steam app ID becomes
prefixManager_explainer: A prefix is a self-contained, virtual Windows filesystem — with its own {drive} and its own registry — for installed programs. Every prefix is completely separate from your actual Linux system and from other prefixes, like its own small Windows install just for this one game.
prefixManager_hint: A new, empty folder or an already existing Wine prefix (e.g. from PortProton, Lutris, or Bottles) — it's initialized automatically the first time the game launches, with the runner you choose for this game.
prefixManager_usedBy: Used by: {games}. These games keep the prefix even if it's only removed from Prefixr.
prefixManager_deleteExplain: The prefix is only removed from Prefixr. The directory on disk, installed programs, and saves inside it stay untouched.
prefixManager_notSetUpTitle: Wine sets it up the first time a game in it starts.
prefixManager_missingTitle: There's no folder at this path. Is its drive mounted?
prefixManager_noMatch: No prefix matches the search or filter.
prefixManager_unreadableTitle: The folder is there, but Prefixr can't look into it (permissions, or a read error).
prefixManager_timedOutTitle: The folder didn't answer in time: a network share that's gone, or a drive still spinning up? Open the page again to check once more.
prefixManager_notListed: This prefix of {games} isn't in the list any more. The game still uses it.
runnerList_explainer: A runner is the compatibility layer that gets a Windows game running on Linux at all — e.g. {proton} (known from Steam) or {wine}. It translates the game's Windows calls into the Linux system, essentially a translation layer between the two worlds.
runnerList_empty: No runners found. Place Proton or Wine builds in the runner directory.
runnerList_deleteConfirmMessage: “{name}” isn't used by any game. Permanently delete the runner folder?
wineTools_winecfg_description: Windows version, library overrides, graphics and drive settings.
wineTools_regedit_description: Edit this prefix's Windows registry directly.
wineTools_cmd_description: Open a Windows command line in this prefix.
wineTools_winefile_description: Wine's own file manager for the virtual C: drive.
wineTools_taskmgr_description: View and end running Windows processes in this prefix.
wineTools_uninstaller_description: Remove installed Windows programs from this prefix.
wineToolsLauncher_hint: Wine's own tools for this prefix ({prefix}) — useful for investigating a problem directly instead of just relaunching a game.
winetricksVerbs_vcrun2022_description: Covers most modern games reporting a missing MSVCP/VCRUNTIME DLL.
winetricksVerbs_vcrun2013_description: For titles from around 2013-2015 that still expect the old msvcr120/msvcp120.
winetricksVerbs_dotnet48_description: For launchers or games whose installer/UI is itself written in .NET.
winetricksVerbs_corefonts_description: Arial, Times New Roman & co. — fixes missing or wrongly rendered text.
winetricksVerbs_d3dcompiler_47_descripti: d3dcompiler_47.dll — often missing on DirectX 9-to-11 titles.
winetricksVerbs_d3dx9_description: Broader than d3dcompiler_47 — for older DirectX 9 titles expecting the full D3DX9 DLL.
winetricksVerbs_xact_description: Fixes missing or silent audio in older DirectX games.
winetricksVerbs_quartz_description: For video cutscenes in older titles that would otherwise stay black or crash.
winetricksVerbs_physx_description: For older games with Nvidia PhysX effects that expect the library explicitly.
winetricksVerbs_gdiplus_description: For older game UIs/launchers built on Microsoft's GDI+ graphics library.
winetricksVerbs_vb6run_description: For very old game installers/launchers still written in VB6.
winetricksInstaller_hint: Installs Windows dependencies directly into this prefix ({prefix}) — affects every game that uses it. Depending on the selection this can take several minutes, since the original files are downloaded from each vendor. A ✓ marks packages already installed.
performanceSettings_mapCountWarningBody: Currently {current}, recommended at least {recommended}. Several modern games (including those with Easy Anti-Cheat, Elden Ring, Baldur's Gate 3, Diablo IV) crash right on launch below this. Steam sets this value itself system-wide — games outside Steam don't get it without this fix.
performanceSettings_hint: How the system treats a running game. Applies to all games and can be overridden per game (edit game → Performance). Each one requires the underlying tool to be installed.
performanceEditor_gamemode_enabled_descr: Optimizes CPU clock and priority while the game runs.
performanceEditor_gamemode_enabled_info: Recommendation: if installed, safe to enable — often gives a noticeable performance boost, especially on laptops or with power saving active. No downside if GameMode is missing. If a competing scheduler daemon is already running (e.g. ananicy-cpp, scx), GameMode is automatically skipped and the performance power profile is used instead, to avoid CPU-priority conflicts.
performanceEditor_power_profile_enabled_: Keeps the power profile on “Performance” while a game runs.

Recommendation: practically always useful on laptops, usually has no effect on desktops without power profiles. Complements GameMode rather than replacing it — GameMode sets the CPU governor itself, which the power-profile service on many distros overrides again. Needs power-profiles-daemon; without it, nothing happens.
performanceEditor_inhibit_sleep_enabled_: Keeps the system and screen awake while a game runs.
Recommendation: practically always useful — stops the screensaver or power saving from kicking in mid-game. Needs systemd-inhibit; without it, nothing happens.
graphicsSettings_hint: What happens to the game's picture before it reaches the screen. Applies to all games and can be overridden per game (edit game → Graphics).
flatpakExtension_hint: In the Flatpak, {tool} needs its extension from Flathub; without it this setting does nothing. Install it with:
flatpakExtension_unavailable: In the Flatpak, {tool} needs its extension from Flathub, which doesn't exist for this runtime yet, so this setting does nothing here.
graphicsEditor_gamescopeDescription: Launches the game in its own, nested compositor session.
graphicsEditor_gamescopeInfo: Recommendation: for handhelds/TV setups, or to force resolution and FPS limit independent of the game. Needs the gamescope package; without it, nothing happens. Skipped when Prefixr itself is already running inside a Gamescope session.
graphicsEditor_vkbasaltInfo: Recommendation: always costs some performance (extra post-processing step) — only enable if you have GPU headroom to spare and care more about the visual result than the last few FPS.
graphicsEditor_sharpenInfo: Recommendation: barely any performance hit — especially worthwhile with upscaling or a lower resolution, to regain sharpness.
graphicsEditor_smaaInfo: Recommendation: can cause a noticeable performance hit. If the game already has its own anti-aliasing, better to leave this off — otherwise it just costs extra performance.
overlaySettings_hint: The MangoHud in-game overlay. On/off and appearance apply to all games and can be overridden per game (edit game → Overlay).
mangohud_presets_minimal_description: Just the FPS number, tucked in the corner.
mangohud_presets_standard_description: FPS, usage, and temperatures at a glance.
mangohud_presets_detailed_description: Every value, including status icons and technical info.
mangohud_presets_competitive_description: Big, bold, nothing else — for maximum clarity.
overlayEditor_mangohudDescription: Shows FPS, usage, and temperatures directly in the game. Requires MangoHud to be installed.
protonSettings_hint: Switches that Proton itself evaluates. Apply to all games with a Proton runner and can be overridden per game (edit game → Proton). “Default” leaves the decision to Proton and protonfixes.
protonSettings_noRunner: No Proton runner installed yet — download one first under “Runners”.
protonOptions_hdr_description: Outputs HDR when the monitor and desktop support it. Usually also needs the Wayland driver or Gamescope.
protonOptions_wayland_description: Native Wayland driver instead of XWayland. Can improve latency and scaling.
protonOptions_wined3d_description: For old DirectX 8/9 games that show graphical glitches or won't start with DXVK.
protonOptions_dlss_description: Replaces the game's DLSS version with the latest. Nvidia only.
protonOptions_fsr4_description: Upgrades FSR 3.1 in the game to FSR 4. AMD RDNA4 only.
protonOptions_fsr4rdna3_description: Like “Update FSR 4”, but with the variant for RDNA3 cards.
protonOptions_xess_description: Replaces the game's XeSS version with the latest.
protonOptions_disablenvapi_description: Turns off DLSS/Reflex support. Helps when a game crashes due to Nvidia detection.
protonOptions_forcenvapi_description: Presents even AMD cards as an Nvidia GPU with NVAPI. For games that otherwise hide DLSS/Reflex options.
protonOptions_nontsync_description: Only for hangs or crashes related to NTSync.
protonOptions_nofsync_description: Only for hangs or crashes related to Fsync.
protonOptions_localshadercache_descripti: Creates the shader cache per game instead of sharing it with other games.
protonOptions_forcelgadd_description: Sets the Large-Address-Aware flag. Helps old, heavily modded games against out-of-memory crashes.
protonOptions_sdlinput_description: Reads controllers via SDL instead of Steam Input.
protonEditor_advancedHint: Other switches from the runner's script, without a description. Only change these if a fix for a game specifically calls for it.
protonEditor_unsetKnownHint: Set, but not recognized by the runner:
githubSettings_hint: The list here calls the GitHub API, which without sign-in only allows 60 requests per hour and then responds with a 403 error. A free personal access token (with no permissions at all, just "Public Repositories") raises the limit to 5000 requests per hour. Create one at github.com/settings/tokens?type=beta and paste it here.
steamGridDbSettings_hint: To fetch cover art for the library, a free SteamGridDB API key is needed. Create one at steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api and paste it here.
umuSettings_hint: Runs Proton runners through umu — the same way Steam itself launches Proton: in the Steam Linux Runtime, with all {options} options and automatic per-game fixes (protonfixes). umu loads automatically the first time a Proton game launches; the Steam Runtime (a few hundred MB) too, once, and is shared with Lutris, Heroic & co.
directXLayers_hint: Wine runners don't ship DXVK and VKD3D-Proton of their own. Prefixr downloads the latest version of each the first time a Wine game starts and links it into the prefix; Proton runners use their own.
directXLayers_updated: DXVK and VKD3D-Proton are up to date.
backendErrors_game_already_running: The game is already starting or running
backendErrors_game_running: The game is still running. Close it first.
backendErrors_game_runs_in_other_instanc: “{game_name}” runs in another Prefixr instance (the window, a Steam shortcut or `prefixr game launch`). Stop it there.
backendErrors_prefix_in_use: “{game_name}” is still running in this prefix. Close the game first.
backendErrors_steam_command_not_found: Steam is running. Please quit Steam and try again.
backendErrors_steam_only_flatpak: Steam is only installed as a Flatpak. The Flatpak isn't allowed to launch programs outside its sandbox, so it can't launch Prefixr either.
backendErrors_steam_not_found: Steam wasn't found. Start Steam once and sign in.
backendErrors_no_steam_account_found: No Steam account found. Sign in to Steam once.
backendErrors_shortcuts_vdf_unreadable: shortcuts.vdf could not be read ({error}). Prefixr is leaving the file unchanged.
backendErrors_unclosed_quote_in_launch_a: Launch arguments: a quotation mark is left unclosed
backendErrors_pkexec_not_installed: pkexec is not installed. Please run manually: {command}
backendErrors_sysctl_change_failed: sysctl change failed or was cancelled (status {status})
backendErrors_winetricks_failed: winetricks exited with status {status} — details in the log: {log_path}
backendErrors_prefix_dir_not_empty: {path} already contains files but doesn't look like a Wine or Proton prefix
backendErrors_git_hub_rate_limited: GitHub's rate limit for unauthenticated requests is exhausted — add a GitHub token in the settings to raise it.
backendErrors_setup_launch_failed: Setup could not be started: {error} — details in the log: {log_path}
backendErrors_python_not_found: Python 3 wasn't found. The store tools need it — install the python3 package of your distribution.
backendErrors_store_not_connected: {store} isn't connected or the login has expired. Connect it again under Stores.
backendErrors_store_invalid_auth_code: That's not a sign-in code. Paste what the steps above describe — the page or the address your browser ended on.
backendErrors_store_login_failed: The sign-in didn't work. The code is only valid once and for a few minutes — open the login page again and use the new code.
backendErrors_store_install_running: “{title}” is still installing. Games of the same store install one after another.
backendErrors_store_busy: “{title}” is still installing. Cancel the install or wait until it’s done, then try again.
backendErrors_store_install_failed: The install failed: {message} — details in the log: {log_path}
native_quitDialog_oneRunning: A game is still running or starting.
native_quitDialog_manyRunning: {count} games are still running or starting.
native_quitDialog_message: {running} Quitting Prefixr will end them too — unsaved progress will be lost.
native_root_message: A Wine prefix created or run as root ends up owned by root instead of you — your normal session then often can't use it anymore, or delete it without sudo. Please start Prefixr as a normal user.
native_config_message:
{error}

Prefixr is leaving the file unchanged. Fix or remove it and restart Prefixr.
gameList_emptyCollection_hint: Open a game and add it to this collection, or have an agent do it with “prefixr category assign”.
details_noCategories: No categories yet. Create one at the top of the library.
details_umuFix: umu-protonfixes knows this game ({id}) and applies its fixes.
details_noUmuFix: Nothing known from umu-protonfixes or ProtonDB.
compat_umuTitle: umu-protonfixes has fixes for this game
categories_intro: Categories group games, like “Kids” or “Co-op”. A game can be in several. An agent can fill them with “prefixr category assign”.
categories_deleteConfirmMessage: “{name}” is deleted. Its games stay in the library.
downloads_empty_hint: Install games from your stores in the library. Running installs show up here.
backup_intro: A backup holds the library with all its settings, categories, favorites and play times, plus the covers and icons. The prefixes and the games' own files stay where they are and aren't in it, nor are the store logins.
backup_createHint: A single file to keep, or to take to another computer.
backup_includeSecrets: Include the SteamGridDB API key and the GitHub token
backup_restoreHint: Replaces the library and all settings with the backup's. What is now is backed up automatically first, so this can be undone.
backup_automaticHint: Prefixr always backs up before a restore, so it can be undone. Automatic backups hold the API keys and stay on this computer. Each takes about as much space as your covers and icons together.
backup_automaticEmpty: None yet. Turn on automatic backups above; otherwise the first one is made before a restore.
backup_automaticToggleHint: Off by default. When on, Prefixr backs up when it starts, if the last backup is old enough and something changed since.
backup_keepHint: Older ones are deleted, the ones before a restore too.
backup_dirDefault: Default: backups/ in Prefixr's data folder
backup_dirHint: Backups in the previous folder stay there and are no longer listed here.
backup_confirmMessage: The library and all settings are replaced with the backup from {when} ({summary}). What is now is backed up first and then shows up under “Automatic backups”.
backup_restored: “{file}” is restored. What was before is the first backup below.
details_untested: Not tested yet. Pick the result above, or let an agent test it (prefixr library test-status).
details_testOutdated: Tested with {runner}. The runner or exe has changed since, so the result may no longer hold.
details_testClear: Click again to clear the test status
gameCard_revealFailed: The file manager couldn’t show the exe: {error}
